AI NEWS BRIEFING — 11 Nov 2026

TOP STORY
Google released Gemini 4 Carbon to all developers and enterprises after two weeks with cyber defenders. It ranks first on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR and Zapier's AutomationBench at $2 per million input tokens, and comes with a /swarm preview that turns one prompt into a team of agents.

5 KEY UPDATES
1. Gemini Robotics 2.5 put Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid on live Mercedes-Benz lines at a reported 96% success rate on parts kitting, 30-100% better than prior baselines.
2. AlphaProof Code formally verified Signal's encryption at machine-code level: about 6.5 million lines of machine-checked Lean proof, done in four weeks.
3. Anthropic launched its IPO roadshow: 825 million shares at $70-$78, valuing it up to about $1.4 trillion, Nasdaq ticker ANT, pricing expected 18 November.
4. OpenAI opened Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, with claimed profiles, product feeds, analytics and Business Agents for US ecommerce.
5. Meituan published 1.6-trillion-parameter LongCat-2.5 weights under MIT, and IFM released the PAN 2 world model with full training code.

CONCEPT OF THE DAY
When the benchmark stops being the argument: formal proof, staged model releases and out-of-band permission checks are replacing accuracy tables as the way AI systems earn trust.

Full briefing: https://dilip457.github.io/ai-news-daily/
